reading: Reye is the exact shared spine of the tomotope and the 24-cell: tomotope edges correspond to 24-cell antipodal axes, tomotope triangles correspond to 24-cell hexagon planes, and the common Levi graph has 48 incidences and 576 automorphisms. The Q4/tomotope/K12 chain is therefore attached to the classical D4/F4 24-cell geometry through the same Reye configuration, not merely through matching counts.
claim_boundary: finite incidence-isomorphism theorem; this identifies a common Reye spine for tomotope and 24-cell combinatorics, not a continuum dynamics proof
